title: Ultimate Puff Chilled Strawberry Pom Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Ultimate Puff’s Chilled Strawberry Pom e-liquid is a sweet and juicy fruit explosion with a frosty twist. You’ll taste freshly-picked, juicy strawberries blended with the sharp, exotic tang of pomegranate, all laced with a streak of ice-cold menthol for maximum refreshment. These premium shortfill bottles contain 100ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 20ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create an e-liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill will give you 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well to combine. Ultimate Juice is a UK e-liquid company with an ever-expanding range of astonishing e-liquid flavours that run the gamut from juicy fruits to mouth-watering candy, decadent desserts, refreshing menthols and many more. With well over 300 juices currently in circulation, their premium e-juices are designed to give you a wealth of options when it comes to your all-day vape. E-liquid in Shortfills are a great way to make your favourite e-liquid last longer, saving you money and trips online and to your local Vapestore to resupply. These e-liquids tend to be high in VG (vegetable glycerin) and are best suited to high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits with low-resistance coils to achieve the best flavour and vapour production from your e-liquid.
